Class ExpressionTck

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.ExpressionTck
public abstract class ExpressionTck extends AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
Operators and array expressions: numeric promotion of arithmetic and shifts, structural and referential equality, and array creation and access, compared with what javac writes for the same source.

A backend runs these tests by extending this class and implementing AbstractByteCodeWriterTck.write(io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ObjectDef).

Since:
2.3
